title: Brick 솔로 #052 · hourglass bombshell · 빨강 단색 블록 · 힙 팝 · 미니멀 로프트 · 강남언니
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, waist-length braids honey blonde hair — full body single-colour interlocking plastic toy-brick sculpture fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid toy-brick body built from thousands of small interlocking glossy plastic bricks stacked in staggered rows, the bricks stepping in tiny stair-like layers along her curves so the whole figure still follows her body's true three-dimensional shape, a regular grid of round cylindrical studs clearly visible on every upward-facing brick surface, thin dark seams between every brick, nothing lying flat. Dense brick surface — BLAZING glossy cherry-red bricks across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID a scattering of pure white bricks forming bold stripes along her sides, and glossy highlights catching on every round stud, glossy hard plastic, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of the same plastic toy bricks, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each longer than her middle finger, made of the same plastic toy bricks with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the brick figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips.

Background: a bright minimalist loft studio with pale concrete floors, tall factory windows, a standard door and a row of standard-height steps, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
